name: Rice Blast
symptoms: Diamond-shaped white to gray lesions on leaves
precautions: Remove infected debris from the field
monitoring: Monitor fields every 3-5 days during high humidity periods.

name: Wheat Rust
symptoms: Yellow, orange, or reddish-brown pustules on leaves and stems
precautions: Apply fungicides early if conditions are favorable for disease
Eradicate volunteer wheat and alternative hosts
monitoring: Scout fields weekly, especially after extended periods of dew or rain.
